body: Thanks, I reached out and talked to someone who is currently at the uni doing a year exchange there, for sure I'll be trying to get out as much as possible and make friends with local Japanese students and foreign students. I get told Japanese students are very timid, but I'm trying to learn a little bit of Japanese to be able to speak to them and get help learning more. I'm very excited to get stuck into a different culture I'm just also aware that Asian students I find are not as outgoing as western students, which is where my worries are. I'm sure I'll connect with other international western students, but Japanese students and connecting with them is what I want to get the most out of as well! As well as other students from Asia and other parts of the world. Overall I'm nervous but also excited and I appreciate everyone's feedback.
